import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx'
# Load Transactions sheet
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Transactions')

# Filter for Education (Shiksha)
edu = df[df['Program'] == 'Education (Shiksha)']

# Sum amount by Expense type
sum_by_type = edu.groupby('Expense type')['Amount (INR)'].sum().reset_index()
sum_by_type = sum_by_type.sort_values('Amount (INR)', ascending=False)

print(sum_by_type)

# Get top expense type
top_type = sum_by_type.iloc[0]['Expense type']
top_amount = sum_by_type.iloc[0]['Amount (INR)']
print(f"Top expense type: {top_type}, amount: {top_amount}")
